evidence.quoted_text:
"manager_restarted": (
            (((manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager") or {})
             .get("pid") or 0) > 0
            and (((manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                 .get("pid") or 0) > 0
            and (manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("pid")
            != (manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("pid")
            and bool(((manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                     .get("invocation_id"))
            and bool(((manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                     .get("invocation_id"))
            and (manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("invocation_id")
            != (manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("invocation_id")),
evidence.reason: The `manager_restarted` predicate checks only positive/differing manager PIDs and nonempty/differing invocation IDs. A guest reboot between the manager before/after probes changes both PID and invocation ID, so the predicate can pass without an actual manager restart, while the separate reboot probes can still satisfy `boot_id_changed`. Requiring nonempty, equal boot IDs on both manager probes is the smallest compatible correctness fix.
